text:
Hi Avery,

I am writing to provide an update on our launch position. While our launch was tentatively scheduled for October 8, 2026, Nia, who owns the security review, has informed us that the review will now complete on October 12 at the earliest. Because the release needs completed approval, and the review may require remediation, no new production date is authorized at this time. 

Despite this shift, I maintain complete confidence in our team to navigate this review process and deliver a secure, high-quality release. 

In the interim, a staging demo can still happen on October 8 using synthetic data. Since you choose whether to accept this workaround, please let me know if you would like us to proceed with the staging demo on that date.

Best regards,

Jordan
Engagement Lead
